title: Smooth connected open spreading with a prescribed embedded fibre
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of finite presentation: locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $s\in S$ and let $T\subseteq Y_s=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be an open subscheme [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-open-immersion] geometrically connected over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]; connectedness includes nonemptiness [def-weil-connected-scheme]. There exist an affine scheme $S_1$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], an etale morphism $a:S_1\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $s_1\in S_1$ mapping to $s$ with residue-field map $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(s_1)$ an isomorphism, and a quasi-compact open $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$, such that the composite $v:V\hookrightarrow Y\times_S S_1\to S_1$ is smooth, every fibre of $v$ is geometrically connected, and $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as open subschemes of $(Y\times_S S_1)_{s_1}$.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, smooth specialization; Tag 057J, lemma-normal-morphism-irreducible, first two proof sentences (connected spreading and restriction of the base-changed morphism); smooth restriction uses Morphisms Tags 01VB, 01VC and 01VA.

proof.text: By [sbc-lem-smooth-criterion], the smooth morphism $h$ is flat. By [sbc-lem-smooth-geometrically-reduced], all fibres of $h$ are geometrically reduced. Its finite presentation is an explicit hypothesis, so these are exactly the morphism hypotheses needed for the flat, geometrically reduced spreading theorem.

source.place: Tag 01VF, lemma-smooth-flat; geometric reducedness: varieties.tex Tag 056T, lemma-smooth-geometrically-normal, after Tag 01VB base change

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-geometrically-connected-fibre-open-spreading] to $h,s,T$. The given $T$ is an open in the scheme-theoretic fibre and is geometrically connected, including nonempty, as required there. Obtain its affine $S_1$, etale $a:S_1\to S$, point $s_1$ over $s$ with unchanged residue field, and quasi-compact open $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$. Its conclusion gives geometrically connected fibres of $V\to S_1$ and the required equality $V_{s_1}=T\times_s s_1$ as embedded open subschemes, not merely an abstract isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, statement; Tag 057J, lemma-normal-morphism-irreducible, first proof sentence

proof.text: Let $p:Y\times_S S_1\to S_1$ be the second projection. Clause (2) of [lem-pc-proper-base-change] makes $p$ smooth, since it is the base change of the smooth $h$ along $a$. This clause requires no properness hypothesis.

The inclusion $j:V\hookrightarrow Y\times_S S_1$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $p$ is smooth by Step 3, so [lem-pc-open-immersion-smooth-composition] makes the composite $v=p\circ j:V\to S_1$ smooth. Together with Step 2 (geometrically connected fibres of $v$, and $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as open subschemes of $(Y\times_S S_1)_{s_1}$) this proves all the assertions.
